about_the_game:
Fire rains from the gloomy skies, the ground trembles with war, and nowhere is safe. This is Warfront.

Developed by students, Warfront is a gritty, action-packed shooter set in the 2010s, an era of rising tensions and covert warfare. With a high-stakes narrative and no rules of engagement, every mission is a battle for survival.

Experience in the Warfront delivers adrenaline-fueled gameplay, explosive set pieces, tactical combat, and intense military operations that will push you to the edge. Navigate a world of war, high-risk plays, and brutal firefights either with your squad, or solo.

Jump into the fight with six diverse Multiplayer launch maps, designed for strategic gameplay and relentless action. Whether battling through war-torn streets, eerie trenches, industrial zones, or covert military installations, Warfront offers a best-in-class competitive experience.

The fight doesn’t stop there—Warfront introduces a horrifying Infected mode, an intense round-based game where players must fend off relentless waves of terrifying screeching alien creatures. Adapt, strategize, and survive against an evolving extraterrestrial threat as you uncover the mystery behind the invasion.

With more content on the horizon, including new maps and PvP game modes, Warfront is just getting started. Prepare for war.

See you on the Warfront.

Soon to come...

content_descriptors.notes:
Contains partial violence:

Slight blood. Voice and text chat can be disabled from the in-game settings menu. Involves killing of other players / alien creatures.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8, 64-bit
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 670 2GB/AMD Radeon HD 7870 2GB or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-4790K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600 or faster
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX / GTX 980 / AMD R9 Fury or better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

Step into the chaos with relentless PvP battles or fight for survival in the horrifying round-based Infected Survival mode. The war is unending, and only the strongest will endure. See you on the Warfront.
